title: fxv user token create command payload
description: Payload schema for the `fxv user token create` command's JSON output.

token_id.description: Unique identifier of the created token.

read_only.description: Whether the token is restricted to read-only access (fetch and clone only).

created_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the token was created.

expires_at.description: Unix timestamp in seconds when the token expires, or null if it does not expire.
